independent_mask_decoder: Published hayro-jbig2 0.4.0, strict mode, all complete packed pixels compared
mask_derivation: Keep the original file/page header through byte43. Select each fixed-length generic segment in turn, number it1, and append empty EOP2. For the coloured segment, exclude only final GBFGCOLID4bytes and clear its colour flag in this mask-only carrier; retain its combination operator. No public bi-level acceptance is inferred from these derived carriers.
rgb_derivation: Initialize opaque white RGB8. In source segment order, independently scan each complete163x109 packed mask (stride21); where its MSB-first bit is1, paint its foreground RGB triple. Coloured background is transparent (T.88 6.2.7); its ID4 means default red (6.8.5/Table30). Monochrome OR paints black ink under the documented RGB presentation contract.
scope: Independent complete-mask/reference construction for the explicit RGB presentation profile, not a claim of full colour conformance or that the original bi-level honeycomb reference is a colour oracle.
